name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for improving scrappy
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? If so, describe it clearly and concisely.

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you'd like to happen. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternatives you've considered and why they don't work as well.

## Affected Areas

- [ ] CLI / flags
- [ ] Export format (JSONL/CSV/XLSX/Parquet)
- [ ] Email extraction / MX verification
- [ ] Quality scoring
- [ ] Memory / performance
- [ ] Proxy support
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] New board (use [New Board template](?template=new_board.md) instead)
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## Implementation Sketch (optional)

If you have ideas for implementation, share them here. For example:

- Which files would need to change
- Which interfaces or types would be affected
- Any trade-offs or open questions

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues before filing this request
- [ ] This feature would benefit multiple users, not just me
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement this (if applicable)
